card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

mechanism: A seeks reassurance that one painting constitutes enough contribution and belonging without a qualifier that diminishes it.
confusable: Unlike wanting a bigger display, A must ask the partner to affirm adequacy of the actual effort.
comparison: D100-a asks for an equal painter introduction; D100-b asks whether staying through the speech can end further practice demands.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
